purpose: If the four prospective tasks supply zero natural conditional-review requests, look for a genuine trigger in a separately reported small-sample development cohort.
order: Three fresh binary numeric tasks, seeds 26171, 26172, 26173 in that order. Each has 300 training records, a mixture of linear and interaction effects, and independent label noise. The same autonomous policy, training-fold derivation, 16-fit ceiling including refits and 600 seconds apply. No task name, seed, or expected winner enters the review. Generate all three training and feature-only packets before examining any of them.
stopping: Run in fixed order only until the first feasible fork is presented to a real reviewer, regardless of keep, refusal, adoption or retention; alternatively until the list is exhausted. No checking performance to choose examples. No labeled outer data are prepared or scored. This diagnoses activation and execution, and supplies no new comparative performance evidence.
budget: Maximum 48 actual fits across the three tasks, one campus DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash call maximum for the cohort, estimated allowance RMB 0.12. Separate new data and canonical task scopes in the same local outbox. No retry and halt new dispatch on unresolved usage.
